A little about me

A builder’s curiosity.
A leader’s perspective.

I’m Hassan, based in Oslo. My work brings together AI, software platforms, business automation, and technical leadership.

I connect product thinking with hands-on architecture: understanding the problem, designing the system, and making the pieces work together. My background spans ERP and CRM integrations, Microsoft Power Platform, and AI-enabled workflows.
